items.summary: An anti-lock braking system is often taken as a promise that the car always stops in the same distance. It is not. After reading this you can describe how the system works, explain where it does not help, choose between threshold braking, progressive braking and engine braking, brake well with or without ABS, and say what to do when the warning light comes on.
items.title: ABS Is Not the Absolute Truth: The Limits of Anti-Lock Braking
